headline: NSE India Sees Record Electronic Gold Receipts Volume on Dhanteras
summary: Trading in Electronic Gold Receipts on the National Stock Exchange of India reached a record 227,000 units during Dhanteras as investors embraced formal gold trading platforms.
why: The National Stock Exchange of India is the country's primary stock exchange, facilitating equity, derivative, and commodity-linked instrument trading.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Record exchange trading volume signals strong investor participation and liquidity.
